title: GetRadioFrequency - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script

Returns the frequency of this radio receiver.

Syntax:
float Function GetRadioFrequency() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
The current frequency this radio is tuned to.

Examples:
Debug.Trace("The radio is currently listening to: " + radio.GetRadioFrequency())
